summary: Situated in this popular and well run community for the over 55s, located in a rural area to the west of Carlisle, with easy access to Dalston which offers a wide range of amenities, a 2 reception, 2 bedroom (master ensuite) detached park home, with low maintenance outside space and ample parking.
description:
Orton Grange Park is a well-maintained development of single-storey park homes offering full 12-month residential occupation, set within a popular rural location to the west of Carlisle.

Conveniently positioned close to the ever-popular village of Dalston, the development is well served by transport links to Carlisle, Wigton and the wider west of the county. A good range of local amenities is available nearby, including a Cranston’s farm shop within walking distance.

The property itself is well presented and benefits from mains services and facilities, offering flexible accommodation comprising an entrance hall with built-in cloak cupboard, a well-equipped kitchen fitted with a gas hob, electric oven, and integrated fridge/freezer and dishwasher, and a lounge with a corner aspect leading through to a separate dining room.

There are two double bedrooms, with the principal bedroom benefiting from an en-suite shower room, along with a further bathroom.

Externally, the home offers parking for two to three vehicles and a low-maintenance garden area with a storage shed.

Providing a cost-effective alternative to traditional bungalow living, early viewing is strongly recommended to fully appreciate the accommodation on offer.

Directions From Carlisle head west on the A595 to reach the roundabout at Orton Grange. Take the first exit towards Dalston and then the first left hand turn to reach Orton Grange Park. On entering the park follow the one way system to reach number 26 which sits on the left.

Services Mains water, electric, gas and drains are connected but have not been tested. Utilities are supplied and invoiced by the site owners.

Key Information: • Non standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking.

The property is leasehold with an annual ground rent and service charge of £2616.00 which covers the water rates, drainage, communal lighting and road maintenance.
